title: A Disassembled Droid
front_description: Mistaken for just another droid, C-3PO is carried down the assembly line of the Geonosian droid factory, only to find his head sliced from his body. His head lands in a line of battle droid heads and promptly welded to a battle droid body. Meanwhile, headless body continues down the assembly line, sandwiched between battle droids. In turn, a battle droid head is eventually welded onto Threepio's body.
back_description: The hapless C-3PO, standing against the droid factory set's bluescreen.
